content: react-tinder-card (3DJakob) is effectively unmaintained: latest npm version 1.6.4 published ~3 years ago, no recent releases. Recommended approach for a web (not React Native) tinder-style swipe deck in 2025/2026 is a custom implementation using the 'motion' library (formerly framer-motion, import from 'motion/react') which has built-in whileDrag/drag gesture support well suited to swipe-card mechanics, rather than relying on the stale react-tinder-card package.
